parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the top of the camera, typically used as the shutter button.
parts.Functional_description: This button is used to capture photos or start recording videos when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary plastic button on the top surface of the camera, possibly for power or mode selection.
parts.Functional_description: This button toggles camera modes or powers the device on and off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly downward when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: A glass lens assembly located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It focuses light onto the image sensor to capture clear images.
parts.Movement_description: It may extend or retract for zooming or focusing, depending on the camera design.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located near the lens, likely for flash or function control.
parts.Functional_description: This button activates or deactivates the flash or other camera features.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the camera, made of durable plastic housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and protection for the internal electronics and optics.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components together.
